request.prompt:
Implement the following change to the application so that it fully satisfies
the specification and all existing and new tests pass. Run the test suite and

Reject creating an owner when another owner already has the same last name and the same telephone number. Respond with 409.

agent.result_text:
Done. The build passes — **258 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors**, including the new `Cp02Tests`.

## What I changed

The requirement is a duplicate-owner rule keyed on **last name + telephone** (a previous chain had implemented an exact all-fields-match rule). I narrowed the check in `ClinicServiceImpl.saveOwner`:

- **`ClinicServiceImpl.java`** — `isDuplicateOwner` now flags a new owner as a duplicate when an existing owner shares the same last name **and** telephone (dropping the first-name/address/city conditions). The thrown `DuplicateOwnerException` message was updated to match.
- **`DuplicateOwnerException.java`** — javadoc updated to describe the new criteria.

The existing 409 handling in `ExceptionControllerAdvice` (maps `DuplicateOwnerException` → `HttpStatus.CONFLICT`) already produces the required 409 response, so no change was needed there.

This satisfies both `Cp02Tests` cases: same last name + telephone → 409, and same last name with a different telephone → 2xx. The prior exact-duplicate test (`Cp01`) still passes since a byte-identical owner necessarily shares last name and telephone.
